thread:
lee_finance: Quick heads-up — HelixCare replied about INV-72003 (private deployment renewal). They say the platform fee was prorated incorrectly after the cutover and support tier toggled to Enterprise mid-bill. They want an itemized breakdown.

ada_sales: I pulled the renewal packet. The amendment AMND-5009 shows a change in billing cadence but Schedule D (platform fee table) has two rows; one row has 'TBD'. Looks messy.

mike_custsuccess: Helix ops says they migrated on 2026-02-10 but the invoice covers 2026-02-01 to 2026-02-28. They expected pro-rata at the old 7% for 1/28 of the month then new flat $14k starting 02-10. They were charged full flat $14k plus the old 7% for the month = double charge.

billing-bot: System note: Invoice INV-72003 lines: ["Commit: $120,000","Platform fee: $21,400","Support: $5,600"], total_due: $147,000. Applied rule: Schedule D flat fee applied for full month; legacy percentage not removed.

lee_finance: Oof. That sounds like a proration bug in the billing engine where both legacy and new rules applied. @cleo_legal can you confirm if Schedule D (with the flat fee) was properly executed with an effective date of 2026-02-10?

cleo_legal: I have the signed amendment but the effective date field is 2026-02-01 and Schedule D has two entries: Line 1 (legacy): 7% during onboarding, Line 2 (new): flat USD 14,000 monthly. The amendment text says "effective on cutover date" but the execution page doesn't specify a cutover. We need to treat effective date ambiguity as unresolved.

ada_sales: Sales notes show verbal confirmation of cutover 2026-02-10 but no signed date. We should not invoice based on informal notes.

lee_finance: Action plan: 1) put INV-72003 on hold, 2) issue provisional credit to remove the duplicate component while we confirm dates, 3) file a bug for proration logic so this doesn't repeat. Who owns each?

mike_custsuccess: I'll tell HelixCare we've paused collection and will issue a corrected invoice once resolved. They asked for an immediate reversal of the extra platform charge.

billing-bot: Creating provisional credit CM-7781 for the duplicate platform amount: calculation snippet: 
```
monthly_flat = 14000
legacy_pct = 0.07
commit = 120000
legacy_fee_full = commit * legacy_pct  # 8400
applied_platform = 21400
duplicate_amount = applied_platform - max(monthly_flat, legacy_fee_full)  # 21400 - 14000 = 7400 (approx)
```

lee_finance: Thanks billing-bot. I'll draft CM-7781 for $7,400 and route for director approval since >$5k. Also logging a billing bug: PR-3810 (proration overlap for cutover).

cleo_legal: While we sort the credit, legal recommends documenting customer's written waiver if they accept a backdated cutover date. Sales should capture signed confirmation to avoid re-dispute.

ada_sales: I'll get HelixCare's ops to sign a brief acknowledgement: either (A) cutover = 2026-02-01 (flat applies full month) or (B) cutover = 2026-02-10 (pro-rate legacy for 9 days, apply flat after). They'll sign (B).

mike_custsuccess: Customer agreed to sign (B) acknowledging credit and corrected invoice. They want the revised invoice within 48 hours.

lee_finance: Routing CM-7781 for approval. Once approved we'll post credit and issue INV-72003-R1 with corrected platform lines and support tier note. Also tagging RevRec for potential ASC adjustments.

billing-bot: Note: PR-3810 created and linked to billing-engine.estimated_impact = "low-medium".

cleo_legal: Confirmed — no legal barrier to issuing the credit. Keep signed customer acknowledgement in contract folder.

lee_finance: Credit approved by director. CM-7781 posted. Invoice updated to INV-72003-R1; status: On Hold -> Corrected Sent. Closing loop after we ingest signed cutover note into contract system.

ada_sales: I uploaded the signed cutover confirmation to the contract repo. Marking AMND-5009 as complete for change control.

mike_custsuccess: HelixCare confirmed receipt of corrected invoice and closure on their side. Great job all.

lee_finance: Closing thread. We'll follow PR-3810 till fix is shipped. Thanks.
